protocol.matching: Exact model ID, actual mass and actual max steering; different episodes AND maps; same reference collection policy. Uniform donor episode then endpoint.
protocol.forecast: Fixed initial context throughout each response forecast; recipient current state and all recorded future actions unchanged. No future observations. Exclude collision/end and all subsequent targets.
protocol.scope: Auxiliary physical-response predictor, not RSSM reward/continuation heads. 5 nominal chassis only; not all 75 randomized profiles. Single training seed; 03 vs 09 also changes injection.
